Graphics & Simulation Notes

A structured set of lecture notes on rendering, physics, and simulation. This site is a long-term technical archive rather than a blog.

Each lecture focuses on building intuition first, then connecting physics, mathematics, and implementation. Over time this will expand into multiple series covering rendering, numerical methods, and simulation systems.
